lines: If the heart already holds His conduct, how sing at all?
Yet it is hymned, suddenly: bow to Śiva-oneness, the first means.
l4.sanskrit_cite: hṛdayam adhiśete yadi tataḥ | kathaṃ stotraṃ kuryād | śivaikātmyaprāptau śivanatir upāyaḥ prathamakaḥ
